newsitem.title: USA: USG spot jet fuel slips lower, NYH firms slightly.
newsitem.headline: USG spot jet fuel slips lower, NYH firms slightly.

text.p: U.S. Gulf (USG) spot jet fuel differentials eased modestly by late Thursday, offsetting the firmer prices seen on the NYMEX.

USG 54-grade barrels for back 8th cycle delivery on the Colonial Pipeline, which hit the scheduling deadline Thursday, were talked on either side of 2.75 cents over the screen, down about 3.00 cents on the day..
USG back 9th cycle 54-grade jet was talked between 2.00 and 2.25 cents over the screen.
New York Harbor prompt 54-grade barrels firmed slightly, with traders putting the "get-done" mark at 2.00 cents over.
NYMEX heating oil futures, the basis price for jet fuel, ended up 0.14 cent on the day, well off its peak off 1.00 cent up.
-- Matt Daily, New York Energy Desk + 1 212 859 1620
